name: Double Bottom
description: A pattern forming two consecutive troughs at approximately the same price level, separated by a peak. It signals that sellers failed to push price below a support level on the second attempt, indicating a potential trend reversal from bearish to bullish.
formation_rules: Price must be in a confirmed downtrend prior to pattern formation
First trough forms as price declines to a support low, then bounces at least 10% to a peak
Second trough forms as price declines back toward the first trough low, within 3% of the first trough
The second trough must not be lower than the first trough by more than 3%
The peak between the two troughs defines the neckline resistance level
Time between the two troughs should be at least 2 weeks on daily charts for significance
The pattern spans a minimum of 4 weeks to be considered valid
volume_rules: Volume is typically higher on the first trough decline than the second. Lower volume on the second decline relative to the first is a bullish signal. Volume must expand at least 1.5x average on the neckline breakout candle for confirmation.
measured_target_method: Measure the vertical distance from the troughs to the neckline peak. Project that distance upward from the neckline breakout point to get the minimum price target.
confirmation_conditions: Price closes above the neckline (peak high) on a daily candle
Breakout candle volume is at least 1.5x the 20-period average volume
A successful retest of the neckline from above followed by a bounce confirms the breakout
Bullish divergence on RSI between the two troughs strengthens the signal
invalidation_conditions: Price closes below either trough low, negating the double bottom structure
Price reclaims and closes below the neckline after a confirmed breakout
The second trough forms on significantly higher volume than the first trough
A bearish engulfing candle forms at the neckline test from above

agent_rules.rule: Breakout is confirmed only when the closing price is strictly above the neckline (peak high between the two troughs); intraday violations without a close are not valid triggers.
Volume on the breakout candle must be >= 1.5x the 20-period SMA of volume; record the pattern as unconfirmed if volume threshold is not met.
Pattern is invalidated if price closes below the lower of the two troughs at any point during or after formation; remove the bullish bias immediately.
The second trough is considered approximately equal to the first if it is within a 3% price range of the first trough; reject patterns where the second trough is deeper than this threshold.
